<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Define paths
input_file = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
output_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"

# Read the long-format input CSV
df_long = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Get unique city IDs
city_ids = df_long['city_id'].unique()

# Get unique years
years = df_long['year'].unique()

# Get all indicator IDs (columns that are not city_id, city_name, or year)
indicator_columns = [col for col in df_long.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Create the output dataframe
df_matrix = pd.DataFrame()

# For each city and year combination
for city_id in city_ids:
    for year in years:
        # Create a new dataframe for this city/year
        df_city_year = df_long[(df_long['city_id'] == city_id) & (df_long['year'] == year)]
        
        # Select only the indicator columns for this city/year
        df_indicator = df_city_year[indicator_columns]
        
        # Reset index to get clean row names
        df_indicator = df_indicator.reset_index(drop=True)
        
        # Create the matrix row
        row = df_indicator.to_dict('records')
        
        # Add city name to the row
        if 'city_name' in df_long.columns:
            row['city_name'] = df_long[df_long['city_id'] == city_id]['city_name'].iloc[0]
        else:
            row['city_name'] = ''
        
        # Add indicator_id as a column
        indicator_id = df_indicator['indicator_id'].values[0] if len(df_indicator) > 0 else ''
        
        # Add value for each indicator
        for ind_col in indicator_columns:
            if ind_col in df_indicator.columns:
                row[ind_col] = df_indicator[ind_col].values[0]
            else:
                row[ind_col] = ''
        
        # Add city_id and year to the row
        row['city_id'] = city_id
        row['year'] = year
        
        # Add as a row to the matrix dataframe
        df_matrix = pd.concat([df_matrix, pd.DataFrame([row])])

# Save to CSV
df_matrix.to_csv(output_file, index=False, encoding='utf-8')

print(f"Output written to {output_file}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df_matrix)}")
print(f"Total indicators: {len(indicator_columns)}")
</solution_file>
